title: Questions that need the learner's Anki data
description: The learner asks about their own Anki deck. Answers must come from the deck (tool calls or pre-loaded context), not guesses. Measures tool-calling cost and grounding accuracy. Pinned to the synthetic fixtures because the gold answers depend on that deck.

turns.text: 我最近用Anki复习单词。你能看看我最近哪些词总是记不住吗？

anki.fact: 讨论 is in the learner's deck but not studied yet (a new card).
火箭 is not in the learner's Anki deck at all.

turns.text: 好的，那我们用这些难的词聊天吧。

checks: The tutor starts a conversation that naturally uses one or two of the learner's hard words (选择, 设计, 印象, 经验, 打算) instead of drilling or listing them.
